sentences.text:
1.
Present petition has filed for quashing of Bongaon P.S. Case No. 103 of 2020 under Sections 498A/406 of the IPC.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that initially a private complaint was filed bearing Complaint Case No.112 of 2019 by the opposite party/wife which was dismissed by the learned court for non-prosecution vide order dated 27th March, 2023.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that while first complaint was pending, the complainant/opposite party filed another compliant bearing Complaint Case No. 18 of 2020 without disclosing the factum of the earlier complaint.
Learned counsel submits that in the second complaint, learned Magistrate passed an order for registration of the FIR on which FIR No.103/2020 was lodged.
Learned counsel submits that subsequently the charge-sheet was also filed.
Learned counsel submits that this is a clear abuse of the process of the court.
a prayer has been made for issuance of the notice and stay of the proceedings.

4. Issue notice to the State of West Bengal through the office of the learned Public Prosecutor.
Opposite party no.2
